test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A park, in the shape of a quadrilateral ABCD, has ∠C = 90°, AB = 36 m, BC = 42 m, CD = 40 m and AD = 36 m. What is the area (in m², rounded off to 1 decimal place) of the park?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Split quadrilateral along BD

Triangle BCD is right-angled → Area = (1/2)×42×40 = 840

Find BD using Pythagoras: BD = √(42² + 40²) = √3364 = 58

Triangle ABD has sides 36, 36, 58 → use Heron’s formula

s = (36 + 36 + 58)/2 = 65

Area = √[65×29×29×7] ≈ 618.5

Total area = 840 + 618.5 = 1458.5

**∴ Answer = 1458.5 m²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

AB = 36, BC = 42, CD = 40, AD = 36, ∠C = 90°

**Formula used:**

Area of right triangle = (1/2)ab, Heron’s formula

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebbc0111a36e3f9939c680df6067d7aaa78eacc5d9811b0eb46b079333d90a48.png] 

⇒ Area of ΔBCD = (1/2)×42×40 = 840

⇒ BD = √(42² + 40²) = 58

⇒ ΔABD with sides 36, 36, 58

⇒ s = 65

⇒ Area = √[65×(65−36)×(65−36)×(65−58)]

⇒ = √[65×29×29×7] ≈ 618.5

⇒ Total area = 840 + 618.5 = 1458.5

**∴ The correct answer is 1458.5 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divide Complex Shape

Split quadrilateral into triangles.

Pythagoras Theorem

Used to find diagonal in right triangle.

Heron’s Formula

Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)]

Accuracy

Round final answer to required decimal places.
